paragraphs: Workday is the enterprise AI platform for managing people, money, and agents. Workday provides more than 11,500 organizations with cloud solutions powered by artificial intelligence ("AI") to help solve some of today's most complex business challenges, including supporting and empowering their workforce, managing their finances and spend in an ever-changing environment, and planning for the unexpected.

We strive to reimagine how work gets done and hope to empower customers to do the same through an innovative suite of solutions with more than 75 million users under contract around the world and across industries – from emerging and medium-sized businesses to more than 65% of the Fortune 500. Central to our purpose is a set of core values – with our employees as number one – along with customer service, innovation, integrity, fun, and profitability. We believe that happy employees lead to happy customers, and we are committed to helping our customers adapt and thrive in this increasingly dynamic business environment.

As organizations face changing conditions, we believe the need for an intuitive, open, scalable, and secure platform that provides unified management of human resources ("HR"), finances, AI agents, suppliers, and planning is more important than ever. Workday AI is built into our platform, allowing us to rapidly deliver and sustain models that can transform business processes and solve countless business problems. Workday's insight into how people, money, and agents move through organizations provides a depth of context in HR and finance, allowing us to understand how and where work gets done and to strategically design solutions to have the greatest impact. As a result, Workday helps deliver better employee experiences, increase productivity, improve operational efficiencies, and provide insights for faster, data-driven decision-making. In fiscal 2026, we introduced new Workday AI agents to accelerate hiring, enhance frontline worker experiences, simplify financial processes, and improve employee information access. In fiscal 2026, we also announced new Workday AI agents that are expected to be available in fiscal 2027, purpose-built to assist with complex human capital management ("HCM") and finance processes, such as performance reviews, workforce planning, and financial close. To support our customers and help them continuously adapt how they manage their business and operations, Workday delivers weekly product updates in addition to

major feature releases throughout the year. Through this model, Workday customers are able to adopt and implement innovations quickly and adapt at a time that fits their business needs. We sell our solutions worldwide through direct sales by our field sales teams; through referrals and our co-selling partners; by reselling through partners; and over Workday Marketplace. We also offer professional services, as do our Workday Services Partners, to help customers deploy our solutions and continually adopt new capabilities.

Workday's open platform enables our customers and partners to innovate by building AI-powered solutions and agents that can work across their organization. In fiscal 2026, we announced Workday Build, a new open developer platform that will give customers and our partners the ability to create and share AI-powered solutions directly on the Workday platform. Workday Build will feature Workday Flowise Agent Builder, a low-code tool designed to simplify building, deploying, and managing custom AI agents within Workday that is expected to be available to early adopter customers in fiscal 2027. In fiscal 2026, we also announced Workday Data Cloud, a new data service based on an open architecture and industry standards, such as Apache Iceberg, designed to enable organizations to gain greater strategic value from their HCM and finance data by connecting to their existing analytics platforms and operational systems with bidirectional, zero-copy access. The Workday Data Cloud includes key partnerships that will allow organizations to share data to and from certain other platforms with Workday, helping organizations to securely connect and analyze HCM and finance data in context with customer, market, and operational data. The Workday Data Cloud is expected to become available later in fiscal 2027.

Our innovation strategy includes the selective acquisition of technologies that complement our core offerings and align with our long-term growth objectives. During fiscal 2026, we expanded our AI capabilities through the acquisitions of FlowiseAI, Inc. ("Flowise"), a low-code platform that makes it easy to build AI agents; Paradox, Inc. ("Paradox"), a candidate experience agent that uses conversational AI to simplify every step of the job application journey; Sana Labs AB ("Sana"), a leading AI company building the next generation of enterprise knowledge tools; and Pipedream, Inc. ("Pipedream"), a leading integration platform for AI agents.

Workday offers a suite of cloud-based enterprise solutions that address the evolving needs of the C-suite on a platform designed to be open, extensible, and configurable, allowing integration with other applications and the ability for customers and our partners to build custom applications. Workday's applications and solutions, including HCM, Financial Management, Spend Management, and Planning, address industry-specific needs and serve customers ranging in size from emerging and medium-sized enterprises to Fortune 500 and global companies.

Workday unifies HR and finance on one platform, helping leaders to empower their organizations with the insights and tools needed to adapt quickly and to make sense of the vast amount of data they collect enterprise-wide. For example, information technology ("IT") leaders are navigating the complexities of supporting employees in evolving environments, which requires them to build and deploy an adaptable, secure architecture to help ensure global continuity and productivity while remaining agile. Our purpose-built AI agents, along with customer- and partner-built agents, can help customers operate with intelligence and efficiency across the organization. The Workday platform combines both the innovation built by Workday with solutions and agents built on the Workday platform by our customers and partners, providing organizations with the flexibility to integrate Built on Workday applications, agents, and services directly into Workday. By managing their people, money, and agents together on the Workday platform, our customers can gain new possibilities for increased agility, transformation, and performance.

In fiscal 2026, Workday introduced Workday Sana, the AI experience platform for enterprise knowledge, agents, and automation across the Workday ecosystem and beyond. Workday Sana enables organizations to leverage AI for knowledge management and search, take action with AI-powered productivity tools, and automate across enterprise systems from a single, intuitive, and unified experience. Workday Sana connects the workforce with HCM, finance, and IT systems and data and is designed to enable use of AI in ways that align with how work gets done.

Workday delivers HCM solutions to help organizations build an agile, skills-based workforce, streamline operations, increase efficiency, and deliver better employee experiences, empowering CHROs to champion the potential of their workforce. Workday's suite of HCM solutions allows organizations to manage the entire employee lifecycle – from recruitment to retirement – enabling HR teams to hire, onboard, pay, develop, retain, and reskill, and provide meaningful employee experiences that are personalized and helpful, based on listening to the diverse needs of today's evolving workforce. We are helping organizations manage their total workforce in one seamless experience on Workday through our solutions, including Workday Adaptive Planning, Workday Wellness, Workday Peakon Employee Voice, Workday VNDLY, and Workday HCM.

Workday's AI-powered talent acquisition solutions, including HiredScore AI for Recruiting, Candidate Experience Agent, and Paradox Conversational Applicant Tracking System, help streamline the recruiting and hiring process.

Workday helps organizations accelerate their journeys towards becoming truly digital finance organizations by giving them solutions and tools designed to optimize essential processes while also supporting growth, profitability, and compliance with regulatory requirements. Workday's suite of financial management applications, built on the Workday platform with AI at the core, helps enable CFOs to manage core financial processes such as payables and receivables; identify real-time financial, operational, and management insights; perform financial consolidation; reduce time-to-close; promote internal controls and auditability; and achieve consistency across global finance operations. Our AI-powered capabilities for finance, including purpose-built AI agents, are designed to transform certain accounting, finance, and procurement processes, helping organizations to efficiently execute complex processes, forecast with predictive insights, reduce friction by connecting with existing systems, and quickly adapt to shifts in business, regulatory, and operational needs.

Workday helps enable procurement professionals to support their businesses throughout the source-to-contract process with a set of spend management solutions that help organizations streamline supplier selection and contract management, build and execute sourcing events, such as requests for proposals, and manage indirect spend. Additionally, Workday offers an expense management solution that provides users with flexible ways to submit and approve expenses, while providing leaders the ability to set controls and analyze spend.

In today's dynamic environment, businesses need to continuously plan and model various scenarios to quickly respond to change. Workday provides an active planning process that can model across finance, workforce, sales, and operational data, helping organizations make more informed decisions and respond quickly to changing situations. Workday AI assists in creating forecasts that incorporate historical and third-party data, such as economic data and labor statistics. When combined with Workday's HCM and Financial Management solutions, organizations are able to leverage real-time transactional data to dynamically adjust and recalibrate their plans.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry
Any slowdown or failure in our technical operations infrastructure or applications may subject us to liabilities and adversely affect our reputation and operating results.

We depend on data centers and other infrastructure operated by third parties, as well as internet availability, and any disruption in these operations could adversely affect our business and operating results.
The markets in which we participate are intensely competitive, and if we do not compete effectively, our operating results could be adversely affected.
We may lose key employees or be unable to attract, enable, and retain highly skilled employees.
If we are not able to realize a return on the investments we have made toward entering new markets and new lines of business, our business and operating results could be adversely affected.
Our international presence, continued expansion, and sales to customers outside the U.S. or with international operations expose us to risks inherent in global operations.
Our business could be adversely affected if our users are not satisfied with the deployment, training, and support services provided by us and our partners.

Our future success depends on the rate of customer subscription renewals, and our revenues or operating results could be adversely impacted if we do not achieve renewals at expected rates or on anticipated terms.
If we fail to develop and maintain widespread positive awareness of our brand, our business may suffer.
If we are unable to successfully integrate our applications with a variety of third-party technologies, our business and operating results could be adversely affected.
Our quarterly results may fluctuate significantly and may not fully reflect the underlying performance of our business.
Catastrophic or climate-related events may disrupt our business.
Our disclosures related to corporate responsibility and sustainability-related matters expose us to risks that could adversely affect our reputation and performance.
Risks Related to Cybersecurity, Data Privacy, and Intellectual Property
paragraphs: Investing in our securities involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information in this report, including the consolidated financial statements and the related notes included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, before making an investment decision. The risks and uncertainties described below reflect our beliefs and opinions as to the factors and events that could materially and adversely affect our business or the market price of our securities in the future. References to past events are provided by way of example only and are not intended to be a complete listing or a representation as to whether or not any of the risks, events, or uncertainties described below have occurred in the past. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. Additional risks and uncertainties that we are unaware of, or that we currently believe are not material, may also become important factors that materially and adversely affect our business. If any of the following risks actually occurs, our business operations, financial condition, operating results, and prospects could be materially and adversely affected. The market price of our securities could decline due to the materialization of these or any other risks, and you could lose part or all of your investment.

The following summary provides an overview of the material risks we are exposed to in the normal course of our business activities. This risk factor summary does not contain all of the information that may be important to you, and you should read these together with the more detailed discussion of risks set forth following this section, as well as elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K under the heading "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations." Additional risks beyond those summarized below, or discussed elsewhere in "Risk Factors" and "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations," may apply to our activities or operations as currently conducted or as we may conduct them in the future, or to the markets in which we currently operate or may in the future operate. Consistent with the foregoing, we are exposed to a variety of risks, including those associated with the following:
•any compromise of our information technology systems or security measures (including of our critical suppliers and service partners), or the unauthorized access of customer or user data;

•any slowdown or failure of our technical operations infrastructure, including data centers operated by third parties, or the impact of service outages or delays in the deployment of our applications, or the failure of our applications to perform properly;
•our ability to compete effectively in the intensely competitive markets in which we participate, including against non-specialist AI-native solutions;

Workday is the enterprise AI platform for managing people, money, and agents. We deliver cloud-based, AI-powered applications for HCM, financial management, spend management, and planning. Our diverse customer base includes emerging, medium-sized, and large global organizations within numerous industries, including financial services, government, higher education, healthcare, hospitality, manufacturing, professional and business services, retail, technology and media, and transportation. Workday helps customers deliver better employee experiences, increase productivity, improve operational efficiencies, and provide insights for faster, data-driven decision-making.

We have achieved significant growth since our inception in 2005, when we pioneered HCM in the cloud. As a result of our innovation and commitment to customer success, today we are a Fortune 500 company with more than 11,500 customers around the world. As we continue to grow, we are focused on driving sustainable, long-term subscription revenue growth by adding new customers and expanding our relationships with existing customers through increased adoption of our suite of solutions. Central to this effort is investing in strategic growth areas including developing innovative AI solutions, expanding internationally, growing our partner ecosystem, deepening our presence in industry verticals and the emerging and medium enterprise market, and exploring strategic acquisitions to complement our organic innovation. Our investments across these targeted growth areas may require additional costs, but we remain committed to optimizing resource allocation and realizing a return on our investments. Over time, we believe these investments will support revenue growth and a more scalable business.

We are focused on expanding our operating margin by driving scale and building efficiencies across the business through investments in people, processes, and systems. As a result of our focus on expanding operating margin, we expect our product development, sales and marketing, and general and administrative expenses as a percentage of total revenues will decrease over the longer term as we grow our revenues and invest in a disciplined manner to support our long-term growth objectives.

paragraphs: Workday 是用來管理人力、資金與代理人的企業 AI 平台。Workday 提供超過 11,500 組組織以雲端解決方案，透過人工智慧（"AI"）協助解決當前一些最複雜的商業挑戰，包括支持與強化其員工、在不斷變化的環境中管理其財務與支出，以及應對未預料的狀況。
我們致力於重新思考工作方式，並希望透過創新解決方案協助客戶做到相同的事。我們的解決方案擁有超過 7,500 萬名用戶簽約，遍及全球各產業 – 從新興與中型企業到超過 65% 的《財富》500 大企業。我們的核心價值觀是我們的員工為第一，加上客戶服務、創新、誠信、樂趣與獲利。我們相信快樂的員工會帶來快樂的客戶，我們致力於協助客戶適應並在這日益動態的商業環境中茁壯成長。

當組織面對變動的環境時，我們認為需要一個直覺、開放、可擴展且安全的平台，提供對人力資源（"HR"）、財務、AI 代理人、供應商與規劃的統一管理，這比以往更加重要。Workday AI 積體在我們的平台中，使我們能快速交付並維持可轉變業務流程與解決無數業務問題的模型。Workday 對於人、資金與代理人如何在組織中流動的洞察，提供了 HR 與財務的深度脈絡，使我們能瞭解工作如何進行，並策略性設計解決方案以產生最大影響。因此，Workday 幫助提供更好的員工體驗、提高生產力、改善作業效率，並提供洞察以進行更快、基於數據的決策。在財務 2026 年，我們推出了新的 Workday AI 代理人以加速招聘、提升現場工作人員體驗、簡化財務流程，並改善員工資訊存取。在財務 2026 年，我們也宣佈了新的 Workday AI 代理人，預計在財務 2027 年推出，專為協助複雜的人力資源管理（"HCM"）與財務流程，例如績效評估、人力規劃與財務結賬。為支持客戶並協助他們持續適應如何管理其業務與作業，Workday 除了全年重大功能更新外，還提供每週產品更新。
我們透過直接銷售由現場銷售團隊進行全球銷售；透過推薦與我們的共售夥伴；透過合作夥伴重新銷售；以及透過 Workday Marketplace。我們也提供專業服務，我們的 Workday 服務夥伴也提供專業服務，協助客戶部署我們的解決方案並持續採用新功能。

Workday 的開放平台使我們的客戶與夥伴能透過建立 AI  powered 解決方案與代理人來創新，這些解決方案與代理人可在其組織內運作。在財務 2026 年，我們宣佈 Workday Build，一個新的開放開發者平台，將讓客戶與我們的夥伴能在 Workday 平台上直接建立與分享 AI powered 解決方案。Workday Build 將包含 Workday Flowise 代理人建構器，一個低碼工具，設計用來簡化在 Workday 中建立、部署與管理自訂 AI 代理人，預計在財務 2027 年對早期採用客戶開放。在財務 2026 年，我們也宣佈 Workday Data Cloud，一個基於開放架構與產業標準，例如 Apache Iceberg 的新數據服務，設計用來讓組織能從其 HCM 與財務數據中獲得更大的戰略價值，透過與其現有分析平台與作業系統進行雙向、零複製存取。Workday Data Cloud 包含關鍵合作夥伴，將允許組織與 Workday 之間共享數據，協助組織安全地連接與分析 HCM 與財務數據，並與客戶、市場與作業數據進行情境化分析。Workday Data Cloud 預計在財務 2027 年後半段開放。

我們的創新策略包括選擇性收購與我們核心業務補充且與我們長期成長目標一致的技術。在財務 2026 年，我們透過收購 FlowiseAI, Inc.（"Flowise"），一個低碼平台，使建立 AI 代理人變得輕鬆；Paradox, Inc.（"Paradox"），一個使用對話式 AI 簡化每一步職務申請旅程的候選人體驗代理人；Sana Labs AB（"Sana"），一家領導 AI 公司，建立企業知識工具的下一代；以及 Pipedream, Inc.（"Pipedream"），一家領導 AI 代理人整合平台，來擴展我們的 AI 能力。
Workday 提供一系列雲端企業解決方案，以應對 C 組長層面不斷變化的需求，這些解決方案建立在一個設計為開放、可擴展與可配置的平台上，允許與其他應用程序整合，並讓客戶與我們的夥伴能建立自訂應用程序。Workday 的應用程序與解決方案，包括 HCM、財務管理、支出管理與規劃，解決產業特定需求，並服務從新興與中型企業到《財富》500 大企業與全球公司的客戶。

Workday 將 HR 與財務統合在一個平台上，協助領導者為其組織提供所需的洞察與工具，以快速適應並理解他們企業範圍內收集的大量數據。例如，資訊科技（"IT"）領導者正在應對支持員工在變動環境中的複雜性，這需要他們建立與部署一個靈活、安全的架構，以確保全球連續性與生產力，同時保持靈活。我們的專為企業設計的 AI 代理人，加上客戶與夥伴建立的代理人，可協助客戶在組織內以智慧與效率運作。Workday 平台結合了 Workday 自行建立的創新與由客戶與夥伴在 Workday 平台上建立的解決方案與代理人，為組織提供靈活性，使他們能直接將建立於 Workday 的應用程序、代理人與服務整合至 Workday。透過在 Workday 平台上管理其人力、資金與代理人，我們的客戶能獲得增加靈活性、轉型與表現的新可能性。

在財務年度2026年，Workday 推出 Workday Sana，這是一個 AI 經驗平台，用於企業知識、代理人及自動化，涵蓋 Workday 生態系統及更廣泛的領域。Workday Sana 讓組織能運用 AI 進行知識管理與搜尋，透過 AI 驅動的生產力工具執行行動，並從單一、直覺且統一的體驗自動化企業系統。Workday Sana 連接員工與 HCM、財務及資訊科技系統與資料，並設計為讓 AI 的運用方式與工作執行方式一致。

Workday 提供 HCM 解決方案，協助組織建立靈活的技能導向 workforce，簡化作業流程，提高效率，並提供更好的員工體驗，使 CHRO 能夠推動其 workforce 的潛能。Workday 的 HCM 解決方案組合讓組織能管理員工全生命週期 – 從招募到退休 – 讓 HR 團隊能招聘、入職、發薪、培訓、留住人才並重新培訓，並提供符合今日不斷進化的 workforce 多樣需求的個性化且有幫助的員工體驗。我們透過解決方案，包括 Workday Adaptive Planning、Workday Wellness、Workday Peakon Employee Voice、Workday VNDLY 及 Workday HCM，協助組織在 Workday 上實現無縫的總 workforce 管理。
Workday 的 AI 驅動人才招募解決方案，包括 HiredScore AI for Recruiting、Candidate Experience Agent 及 Paradox Conversational Applicant Tracking System，協助簡化招募與聘僱流程。

Workday 協助組織加速成為真正數位財務組織的旅程，透過提供解決方案與工具，以優化關鍵流程，同時支持成長、獲利及符合法規要求。Workday 的財務管理應用組合，建於 Workday 平台，以 AI 為核心，協助 CFO 管理核心財務流程，如應付帳款與應收帳款；識別即時的財務、作業與管理見解；執行財務合併；縮短結帳週期；促進內部控制與審計性；並在全球財務作業中實現一致性。我們的 AI 驅動財務能力，包括專為設計的 AI 代理人，旨在轉變部分會計、財務與採購流程，協助組織高效執行複雜流程，以預測性見解進行預測，透過與現有系統連結減少摩擦，並迅速適應業務、法規與作業需求的變化。
Workday 協助採購專業人員在其業務的 source-to-contract 流程中提供支援，透過一套花費管理解決方案，協助組織簡化供應商選擇與合約管理，建立並執行採購活動，如請求提案，並管理間接花費。此外，Workday 提供一個費用管理解決方案，讓使用者能以靈活的方式提交與核准費用，同時讓領導者能設定控制並分析花費。
在當前動態的環境中，企業需要持續規劃與建模各種情境，以快速應對變化。Workday 提供一個主動的規劃流程，可建模財務、workforce、銷售與作業資料，協助組織做出更明智的決策並迅速應對變化的情況。Workday AI 協助建立預測，整合歷史與第三方資料，如經濟資料與勞動統計資料。當與 Workday 的 HCM 與財務管理解決方案結合時，組織能運用即時交易資料動態調整與重新校準其計畫。

paragraphs: 下列有關本公司財務狀況及營運成果之討論，應與本報告第二部分第八項所載之合併財務報表及其附註一併閱讀。下列討論包含前瞻性陳述，反映本公司之計畫、預估及信念。本公司實際結果可能與前瞻性陳述中所討論者有重大差異。導致或促成此等差異之因素，包括下列所討論及本報告其他處所提及之內容，特別是在本報告第一部分第一A項所載之「風險因素」。

下列有關本公司財務狀況及營運成果之討論，涵蓋財務年度2026年及2025年項目，以及財務年度2026年與2025年之年對年比較。未包含於本10-K表格之財務年度2024年項目及財務年度2025年與2024年之年對年比較，可於本公司於2025年3月11日向證券交易委員會提交之財務年度截至2025年1月31日之年度報告（Form 10-K）之第二部分第七項「管理層對財務狀況及營運成果之討論與分析」中找到。
本報告中之數字因四捨五入關係，可能無法重新計算。年對年比較、營運毛利及每股淨收入係使用未四捨五入之資料計算。

Workday為企業用以管理人力、資金及代理人的AI平台。我們提供基於雲端、AI驅動之應用程式，用於人力資源管理（HCM）、財務管理、支出管理及規劃。我們多樣化的客戶羣包括各產業中處於成長階段、中型及大型之全球組織，包括金融服務、政府、高等教育、醫療、旅館、製造、專業與商業服務、零售、科技與媒體以及運輸等產業。Workday協助客戶提供更佳之員工體驗、提高生產力、改善營運效率，並提供洞察以實現更快、基於數據的決策。

自本公司於2005年成立以來，我們已實現顯著成長，當時我們率先將HCM雲端化。由於我們的創新及對客戶成功的承諾，今日我們已成為《財富》500大企業，擁有超過11,500位全球客戶。隨著我們持續成長，我們致力於透過增加新客戶及擴大與現有客戶之關係，以提升對我們解決方案之採用率，來推動可持續、長遠的訂閱收入成長。此項努力的核心為投資於戰略性成長領域，包括開發創新AI解決方案、擴展國際業務、成長我們的夥伴生態系、深化我們在產業垂直領域及新興與中型企業市場之存在，以及探索戰略性收購以補足我們的內生創新。我們在這些目標成長領域之投資可能需要額外成本，但我們仍致力於優化資源配置並實現投資回報。隨著時間推移，我們相信這些投資將支持收入成長及更具可擴展性之業務。
我們致力於透過對人力、流程及系統之投資，來擴大營運毛利並推動規模經濟與業務效率。由於我們對擴大營運毛利之關注，我們預期隨著收入成長，並以紀律方式投資以支持我們長遠成長目標，產品開發、銷售與行銷及一般及行政費用佔總收入之百分比將在長遠期間下降。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關的風險
若我們的技術運作基礎設施或應用程式出現遲緩或故障，可能會使我們面臨責任，並對我們的聲譽及營運成果產生負面影響。
我們依賴第三方運營的資料中心及其他基礎設施，以及網際網路的可用性，若這些運作中斷，可能會對我們的業務及營運成果產生負面影響。
我們參與的市場競爭激烈，若我們無法有效競爭，可能會對我們的營運成果產生負面影響。
我們可能失去關鍵員工，或無法吸引、培訓並留住高技能人才。
若我們無法從投入新市場及新業務線的投資中獲得回報，可能會對我們的業務及營運成果產生負面影響。
我們的國際業務佈局、持續擴張以及向美國境外客戶或具有國際業務的客戶銷售，使我們面臨全球運營固有的風險。
本公司業務若因用戶對本公司及其合作夥伴所提供之部署、訓練及支援服務不滿意而受到影響，將可能遭受不利影響。
本公司未來之成功取決於客戶訂閱續約率，若本公司無法在預期速率或預期條款下達成續約，則本公司之營收或營運結果可能受到不利影響。
若本公司未能發展並維持廣泛正面之品牌認知度，本公司業務可能受到影響。
若本公司無法成功將本公司應用程式與多種第三方科技整合，本公司業務及營運結果可能受到不利影響。
本公司每季之營運結果可能出現顯著波動，且可能無法完全反映本公司業務之實際表現。
重大或與氣候相關之事件可能幹擾本公司業務。
本公司有關企業責任及永續相關事項之揭露，使本公司面臨可能影響本公司聲譽及營運表現之風險。

paragraphs: 投資本公司證券涉及高度風險。您應謹慎考量下列所描述的風險與不確定性，並配合本報告中所有其他資訊，包括合併財務報表及相關附註，再做投資決定。下列所描述的風險與不確定性反映本公司對可能對本公司業務或本公司證券市場價格產生重大且不利影響的因素與事件的信念與觀點。提及過去事件僅為範例，並非表示下列所描述的風險、事件或不確定性是否已於過去發生。下列所描述的風險與不確定性並非本公司所面臨的唯一風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，本公司尚未知悉，或目前認為不具重大性，但未來可能成為對本公司業務產生重大且不利影響的重要因素。若任何下列風險實際發生，將可能對本公司業務運作、財務狀況、營運成果與前景產生重大且不利影響。本公司證券的市場價格可能因這些或任何其他風險的實現而下跌，您可能損失部分或全部投資。

下列摘要提供對本公司在正常業務活動中所面臨的重要風險的概覽。此風險因素摘要並未包含所有對您可能重要的資訊，您應配合本節後續更詳細討論風險的內容，以及本年度10-K表報告中「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」部分的內容一併閱讀。除下列摘要或「風險因素」與「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」部分所討論的風險外，尚有其他風險可能適用於本公司目前或未來的業務活動，或本公司目前或未來可能經營的市場。
•本公司資訊科技系統或安全措施遭妥協（包括關鍵供應商與服務夥伴），或客戶或使用者資料遭未經授權存取；
